mapper.select: /* CastConfigMapper.retrieveCategoryList */ SELECT A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.ATRB_GROUP_NM, ' ') AS ATRB_GROUP_NM, CASE WHEN A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = #{baseFixAtrbGroupId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BASE_YN, CASE WHEN A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = #{prePrcsFixAtrbGroupId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PRE_PRCS_YN, NVL(A.CFMTN_YN, 'N') AS CFMTN_YN, NVL(A.GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, ' ') AS GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS FRST_REG_DT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP A WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CASE A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID WHEN #{baseFixAtrbGroupId} THEN 0 WHEN #{prePrcsFixAtrbGroupId} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID

/* CastConfigMapper.retrieveCategoryForUpdate */ SELECT A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.ATRB_GROUP_NM, ' ') AS ATRB_GROUP_NM, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP A WHERE A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = #{fixAtrbGroupId} AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' FOR UPDATE WAIT 3
mapper.insert: /* CastConfigMapper.insertCategory */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP ( FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, ATRB_GROUP_NM, CFMTN_YN, GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, DEL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{fixAtrbGroupId}, #{atrbGroupNm}, 'N', '01', 'N', #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{frstRegDt}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.select: /* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAvailableCategoryId */ SELECT LPAD(MIN(C.CATEGORY_NO), 3, '0') FROM ( SELECT LEVEL + 1 AS CATEGORY_NO FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 498 ) C WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP A WHERE A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = LPAD(C.CATEGORY_NO, 3, '0') )

/* CastConfigMapper.retrieveCknctTypeAtrbList */ SELECT A.ALN_CD AS ATRB_CD, ' ' AS DTL_SE_CD, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.CKNCT_RT), ' ') AS CKNCT_RT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.KOS_RT), ' ') AS KOS_RT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.MOBL_RT), ' ') AS MOB_RT, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.SRVC_HR), ' ') AS SRVC_HR, A.ALN_CD AS ATRB_CD_NM, ' ' AS DTL_SE_CD_NM, 'Number' AS CATALOG_VL_TYPE, 'Y' AS PRE_PRCS_YN FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_TYPE_ATRB A WHERE A.CKNCT_TYPE_ATRB_ID = #{fixAtrbGroupId} ORDER BY A.ALN_CD
mapper.insert:

,

,
, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM A WHERE 1 = 1 AND = '001'

/* CastConfigMapper.insertAplyHstry */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY ( APLY_SN, APLY_SET_SN, SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, TMNL_ID, TBL_NM, SHEET_NM, APLY_ROW_CNT, CNCL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{aplySn}, #{aplySetSn}, #{srcFixAtrbGroupId}, #{tgtFixAtrbGroupId}, #{tmnlId}, #{tblNm}, #{sheetNm}, #{aplyRowCnt}, 'N', #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: /* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAplyHstryDtlList */ SELECT A.APLY_SN AS APLY_SN, A.ATRB_CD AS ATRB_CD, A.DTL_SE_CD AS DTL_SE_CD, A.COLUMN_NM AS COLUMN_NM, A.BEF_VL AS BEF_VL, A.AFT_VL AS AFT_VL FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY_DTL A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.APLY_SN = #{aplySn} ORDER BY A.ATRB_CD, A.DTL_SE_CD, A.COLUMN_NM

/* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAplyHstry */ SELECT A.APLY_SN AS APLY_SN, A.SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.TMNL_ID, ' ') AS TMNL_ID, NVL(A.TBL_NM, ' ') AS TBL_NM, NVL(A.SHEET_NM, ' ') AS SHEET_NM, NVL(A.APLY_ROW_CNT, 0) AS APLY_ROW_CNT, NVL(A.CNCL_YN, 'N') AS CNCL_YN, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS FRST_REG_DT, NVL(A.FRST_RGTR_ID, ' ') AS FRST_RGTR_ID FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY A WHERE A.APLY_SN = #{aplySn}
mapper.update: /* CastConfigMapper.updateAplyHstryCancel */ UPDATE PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY A SET CNCL_YN = 'Y', CNCL_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CNCL_RGTR_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.APLY_SN = #{aplySn} AND A.CNCL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY N WHERE N.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AND NVL(N.TMNL_ID, ' ') = NVL(A.TMNL_ID, ' ') AND N.TBL_NM = A.TBL_NM AND NVL(N.CNCL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND N.APLY_SN > A.APLY_SN )
mapper.select: /* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAplySetHstryList */ SELECT A.APLY_SET_SN AS APLY_SET_SN, A.SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.APLY_ROW_CNT, 0) AS APLY_ROW_CNT, NVL(A.CNCL_YN, 'N') AS CNCL_YN, CASE WHEN NVL(A.CNCL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_SET_HSTRY N WHERE N.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AND NVL(N.CNCL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND N.APLY_SET_SN > A.APLY_SET_SN ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS REVERTABLE_YN, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS FRST_REG_DT, NVL(A.FRST_RGTR_ID, ' ') AS FRST_RGTR_ID FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_SET_HSTRY A WHERE A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = '001' ORDER BY A.APLY_SET_SN DESC

/* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAplySetHstryForUpdate */ SELECT A.APLY_SET_SN AS APLY_SET_SN, A.SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.APLY_ROW_CNT, 0) AS APLY_ROW_CNT, NVL(A.CNCL_YN, 'N') AS CNCL_YN FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_SET_HSTRY A WHERE A.APLY_SET_SN = #{aplySetSn} FOR UPDATE WAIT 3

/* CastConfigMapper.retrieveAplyHstryListBySet */ SELECT A.APLY_SN AS APLY_SN, A.APLY_SET_SN AS APLY_SET_SN, A.SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS SRC_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.TMNL_ID, ' ') AS TMNL_ID, NVL(A.TBL_NM, ' ') AS TBL_NM, NVL(A.SHEET_NM, ' ') AS SHEET_NM, NVL(A.APLY_ROW_CNT, 0) AS APLY_ROW_CNT, NVL(A.CNCL_YN, 'N') AS CNCL_YN FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_HSTRY A WHERE A.APLY_SET_SN = #{aplySetSn} ORDER BY A.APLY_SN
mapper.update: /* CastConfigMapper.updateAplySetHstryCancel */ UPDATE PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_SET_HSTRY A SET CNCL_YN = 'Y', CNCL_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CNCL_RGTR_ID = #{loginUserId} WHERE A.APLY_SET_SN = #{aplySetSn} AND A.CNCL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PMOWN.TH_PM_SMLT_ATRB_APLY_SET_HSTRY N WHERE N.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = A.TGT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AND NVL(N.CNCL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND N.APLY_SET_SN > A.APLY_SET_SN )
